## Recoverable evidence

All 34 artifacts below are inert gzip/base64, with exact byte counts and SHA-256. Original four deliverables are archived as inputs, not copied as a repository snapshot. The incoming handoff manifest was freshly authenticated; older nested archives were not reauthenticated. To recover, copy the following bootstrap to `recover.py`, then run `python3 recover.py HANDOFF.md OWNED-DISK-DIRECTORY`. It verifies hashes before writing and uses apply_patch. To replay the verifier, set `TAUCETI_REPO` to the existing repository and pass the pinned declaration index to `verify.py`; git reads are immutable, no checkout/commit required. Reassemble with `N29_MATHLIB` naming the existing pinned Mathlib tree. Compiler scripts take existing build/toolchain paths as arguments and never install anything. Public evidence supports scratch cleanup; no local artifact path is needed afterward.

### Recovery bootstrap

```python
"""Recover authenticated UTF-8 artifacts from this public handoff via apply_patch."""
from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,re,base64,gzip,hashlib,subprocess
handoff=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text();target=Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve();target.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
blocks={m[0]:m[1]for m in re.findall(r'^### artifact: ([^\n]+)\n\n```[^\n]*\n(.*?)^```',handoff,re.M|re.S)}
manifest=json.loads(blocks['ArtifactManifest.json']);checks=[]
for row in manifest:
 name=row['output'];assert Path(name).name==name and name not in ['.','..']
 data=gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(blocks[row['artifact']]))
 assert len(data)==row['bytes']and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==row['sha256'],name
 text=data.decode();assert text.endswith('\n'),name
 p=target/name
 if p.exists():
  old=p.read_text()
  if old==text:checks.append(name);continue
  prefix='*** Update File: '+str(p)+'\n@@\n'+''.join('-'+s+'\n'for s in old.splitlines())
 else:prefix='*** Add File: '+str(p)+'\n'
 patch='*** Begin Patch\n'+prefix+''.join('+'+s+'\n'for s in text.splitlines())+'*** End Patch\n'
 subprocess.run(['apply_patch'],input=patch,text=True,check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
 assert p.read_bytes()==data,name
 checks.append(name)
print(json.dumps({'authenticatedArtifacts':len(checks),'outputs':checks},indent=2))
```
